title: Ordinary etale orientation family with canonical affine trace
statement: Fix the finite-type spaces of [def-sf-datum], a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$ and an integer $N>0$ killing $A$ and invertible on every space. Let $T_{X,d}=L_X(d)[2d]$ be the ordinary etale root line [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], including the coefficient unit at $d=0$. An ordinary etale geometric orientation family consists of $T_{X,d}\cong f^\times A_Y$ for every smooth separated finite-type $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$. Its base-change equality uses the actual counit transpose of inverse compact-support exchange and the root-normalized line pullback, for every separated finite-type base change. Its composition equality uses twist multiplication, the counit transpose of inverse projection, and the adjunction mate of compact-support composition. On $\pi:\mathbf A^1_Y\to Y$ its adjoint transpose is the canonical comparison to $Rq_*j_!T_{\mathbf A^1_Y,1}$ followed by $Rq_*$ of the open counit and the normalized projective-line trace [def-amb-p1-trace]. Here $j$ is the standard affine chart, $q:\mathbf P^1_Y\to Y$, and $Y$ may be any Noetherian finite-type base, with no separatedness assumption. The family includes the zero-dimensional case and makes no existence assertion. The derived root-line coordinates are those of [def-sf-orientation-etale-line-comparisons].
